environment: Observed local desktop background load. Record CPU/GPU/free-VRAM before and after every process; preserve original quiet qualification labels. Include every started sample, never remove or replace a slow/interfered run. No isolated-machine claim.
task: CPU seeds -> visibility -> exclusive scan -> stable compaction -> tile bins -> 12-frame RGBA atlas -> full CPU readback -> buffered file export. Repeat 12 actual requests per fresh process, including first-use preparation and final cleanup. Conventional CPU implementation computes identical outputs using shared immutable caches.
boundary: Primary: (first-use + next 11 complete requests + cleanup)/12. First-use includes input generation, renderer creation, shader compile and initial upload as applicable. Excludes process/JIT startup outside the measured caller, oracle checks and validation gaps; whole process wall time is also retained as diagnostic. No durable flush, display/presentation or Unity claim.
cache: Ordinary warm OS/filesystem/driver caches; fresh renderer/process each run, no cache purge. All request phases, including three labeled warmups, count in lifetime cost.
inference: Nine balanced cyclic orders, each arm once per position. Eight paired mean-ratio bootstrap comparisons of fixed wave-tiled against every alternative, Bonferroni adjusted. Report first use and steady requests separately without inferring lifetime benefit from them. All conclusions conditional on this single input/session.
stop: One 81-process cohort; maximum 15 minutes, 8 GiB output growth estimate, 30 GiB disk reserve and 4 GiB available host memory. No retry, optimizer sweep or other project follows automatically.
